Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #19: M101: hook boundary, fault containment, config swap (cleanup S1)

1. Safer start-up and shutdown. The plugin now hooks the game only once it is fully loaded, and a fault in one of its hooks switches that hook back to the game's normal behaviour once instead of erroring repeatedly; Status shows when that happened. Nothing should look or play differently.
2. Fixed two action hooks that read the game's yes/no answer as a wider value than the game writes.

Minor: a config save interrupted at the wrong moment can no longer leave you with defaults; shutdown finishes every cleanup step even if one fails.
